adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/larkcalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh path now always does `const appAccessToken = await getAppAccessToken();` and then calls `refreshOAuthTokens(...)`. When credential sync is enabled, `refreshOAuthTokens` bypasses the Lark refresh call and instead `fetch`es `process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (returning whatever that endpoint responds with). However, the subsequent code still passes that response into `handleLarkError<RefreshTokenResp>(resp, ...)`, which is the Lark-specific response handler. The sync endpoint is documented in the diff (`refreshOAuthTokens` comment / `.env.example`) as returning a minimal token response, not Lark’s native envelope, so the existing Lark parsing/handling will not match and can throw. Additionally, `getAppAccessToken()` is executed even in delegated/sync mode, so a self-hoster relying on the parent app (and not configuring Lark app keys locally) could fail before delegation happens.
